author: JayzTwoCents
description:
The Steam Machine is a colossal flop... mostly due to the insane price vs the actual performance. So today with the help of Micro Center (and no bundle deals) we show you how to build a console sized PC that absolutely DESTROYS the Steam Machine in performance for the same price! 

Shop Micro Center's Tech Days: https://micro.center/384008
Sign up for a FREE 128 gig flash drive at Micro Center Austin: https://micro.center/511748
Sign up for a FREE 128 gig flash drive at Micro Center Columbus: https://micro.center/b7e3f7
Visit Micro Center News: https://micro.center/96632f

Parts List: 
Case - Fractal Design Ridge
CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
Mobo: Gigabyte A620i AX AM5
Memory: 16GB G.Skill DDR5-6000 (Single Stick, boo)
PSU: Lian-Li SFX SP750 V2 Gold
GPU: ASRock Challenger 9060XT 16GB
Cooler: Thermalrite AXP-90 X53

How to Install Bazzite Video: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sa8nMiEoti0
